gallery.alt: A smiling host gestures towards a group's finished paintings of a woman with a parasol in a meadow, displayed on small table easels in a bar with an exposed brick wall.
About twenty guests hold up their finished versions of 'The Scream' in a lounge with pink neon signs and lit wine shelves.
The host speaks into a blue microphone beside an easel holding a painted version of 'The Scream', with pink-lit wine shelves and guests behind her.
Guests paint landscape canvases along a long table in a room with floral wallpaper, framed pictures and globe pendant lights.
A long table set up before a session, with blank canvases on table easels, paint palettes, brushes and printed reference pictures of sunflowers on a green tablecloth.
A group of guests hold up their finished cat-portrait paintings in a restaurant with a patterned tile floor.

notes: No video footage exists in any allowed source (no official website; TikTok @_paint_and_pour_ not public; Instagram login-walled; Booked Events and Eventbrite pages have no video). The reel is a still-photo reel built from the business's six own published photos.

Reel stills: the two Eventbrite originals (3616x4156, 3530x1713) were downscaled to 2400 px; the four smaller photos (1000x800, 765x1020, 480x640 x2) were upscaled with Lanczos and a light unsharp mask before the push-in, so segments 2, 3, 4 and 6 are visibly softer than the hero.

Logo is a traced vector reconstruction of the Booked Events-hosted 1000x1000 PNG (the business's listing logo), not the business's own vector file. The raster was posterised into its three colours (black, white, light blue #99c8ff) at 3600 px with a 1 px ink erosion to offset logo_trace.py's dilation; the white disc and light-blue ring were then written as exact SVG circles. Mean absolute RGB difference vs the original: 3.6 on white, 3.4 on navy.

The business's newer Eventbrite profile logo (June 2026) is a different rendition of the same design (terracotta/maroon on a crumpled-paper photo texture, 506 px JPEG); ask the business for its current vector master.
Gallery photos 03-06 are published at their native sizes (1000, 765, 480 and 480 px wide); they were not upscaled. The Booked Events gallery's OpenArt AI-generated images were excluded.
Plate is 'none' because the mark carries its own white disc inside a black and light-blue ring.
